one_liner_en: The linen blouse that keeps you cool and put-together on the hottest Israeli days.

positioning.core_promise: Stay cool and look effortlessly put-together, even at 35 degrees.
positioning.primary_pain: Synthetic tops stick and cling in the heat, and fitted cuts show every spot you'd rather not.
positioning.primary_desire: Feeling elegant and like herself without thinking about it.
positioning.differentiator: A breathable linen blend in a soft A-line that skims instead of clings — relaxed, but never sloppy.

objections.answer: The linen blend wrinkles less than pure linen, and the light texture is part of the relaxed-chic look.
The white is lightly sheer in bright sunlight; we recommend a nude bra.
The cut is relaxed. Order your usual size; between sizes, choose the larger one.
You have 30 days to return it.

pricing.bundle: Buy 2 colors, save 20% on the second

specs.care: Machine wash 30°C, do not tumble dry
